rename_dialog.title: Rename machine
rename_dialog.description: Used for this machine and all its runtimes.

online.label: Online
online.description: Heartbeat received in the last 45s. Ready to dispatch runs.

recently_lost.label: Recently lost
recently_lost.description: Lost contact under 5 minutes ago — often a brief network blip.

offline.label: Offline
offline.description: No heartbeat for 5+ minutes. Restart the daemon or investigate the host.

long_offline.label: Long offline
long_offline.description: No heartbeat for 6+ days. If this host will stay offline, rebind its agents to another runtime or delete this runtime.

detail.no_agents: No agents are bound to this runtime yet.

visibility_hint.private: Only you can create agents on this runtime.
visibility_hint.public: Any workspace member can create agents on this runtime.

visibility_hint_readonly.private: Only the runtime owner can create agents on this runtime, and only they can switch it to Public.
visibility_hint_readonly.public: Any workspace member can create agents on this runtime. Only the runtime owner can switch it back to Private.

visibility_revoke_dialog.title: Make this Runtime private?
visibility_revoke_dialog.description: Making "{{name}}" private will unbind {{count}} teammate agents, cancel {{taskCount}} active runs on this machine, and pause active autopilots assigned to those agents. Your own agents and runs are unaffected.
visibility_revoke_dialog.warning: Access is revoked immediately on the server. Connected daemons stop through their normal cancellation check. An offline machine cannot receive the stop request until it reconnects; its local process may continue meanwhile.
visibility_revoke_dialog.plan_changed: The access plan changed while this dialog was open. Review it and confirm again.
visibility_revoke_dialog.checkbox: I understand that the listed teammate agents will be unbound, their active runs cancelled, and their active autopilots paused.
visibility_revoke_dialog.toast_success: Runtime is now private and teammate access was revoked

delete_dialog.self_heal_notice: This runtime is managed by a running local daemon. Deleting it will succeed, but the daemon will re-register a fresh runtime within seconds — stop the daemon process first to remove it permanently.
delete_dialog.profile_backed_notice: This runtime was registered from a custom runtime profile. Deleting it removes only the current runtime instance; a running daemon can register it again while the profile remains. Delete the custom runtime profile from Custom runtimes to remove it permanently.

light.title: Delete Runtime?
light.description: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

cascade.title_one: Unbind {{count}} agent and delete this Runtime?
cascade.title_other: Unbind {{count}} agents and delete this Runtime?
cascade.description: Delete "{{name}}". The agents below are kept — their instructions, chats and run history stay intact — but they will be unbound and cannot run until you bind them to another runtime. Their queued or in-progress runs will be cancelled, and then the Runtime will be deleted.
cascade.warning: Queued and in-progress runs will be cancelled, and these agents cannot be assigned new work until they are bound to a runtime.
cascade.notice_runtime_has_active_agents: Active agents were added since you opened this dialog. Review the new plan and confirm.
cascade.notice_runtime_delete_plan_changed: The active agent set changed while this dialog was open. Review the new plan and confirm.
cascade.checkbox_one: I understand this {{count}} agent will be unbound and cannot run until I bind it to a runtime, and that any queued or in-progress runs will be cancelled.
cascade.checkbox_other: I understand these {{count}} agents will be unbound and cannot run until I bind them to a runtime, and that any queued or in-progress runs will be cancelled.

detail_page.not_found_hint: It may have been deleted or you may not have access.

connect.title: Add a machine
connect.description: Run these two commands on the machine you want to add. We'll detect it the moment the daemon comes online.
connect.step2_hint: Opens a browser to sign in, then keeps the daemon running in the background.
connect.troubleshooting: Can't open a browser on that machine?
connect.trouble_intro: Use a token instead of the browser sign-in. This replaces step 2 and works anywhere you have a terminal.
connect.trouble_token_hint_suffix: . The daemon only makes outbound connections — no inbound ports required.
connect.success_description: Machine connected. You can now create an agent.

cloud_runtime.toast_create_failed: Failed to create Cloud Runtime node
cloud_runtime.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this cloud node? This action cannot be undone.

update.managed_by_desktop_title: The CLI binary is managed by Multica Desktop — update Desktop to upgrade the CLI.
update.read_only_title: Only runtime owners and workspace admins can update the CLI.
update.local_build_title: This runtime reports a non-release version, so Multica cannot tell whether an upgrade is available. Update it from the machine itself.

list.delete_permission_hint: Only the runtime owner and workspace admins can delete this runtime
list.delete_admin_hint: Only the runtime owner and workspace admins can delete a runtime.

profiles.unassigned_description: These workspace runtimes are not connected to any machine. Connect a machine with the matching commands, or use a row's actions to edit or delete them.
profiles.dialog_description: Custom runtime definitions are workspace-wide and sync to every connected machine. A machine registers the runtime when the command is available there.
profiles.create_dialog_description: Set up a custom command from {{machine}}. The definition syncs workspace-wide and registers only on machines where that command is available.
profiles.builtin_section_hint: Built-in families are read-only reference options.
profiles.empty_description: Pick a base protocol family, then point Multica at the command to run.

builtin_detail.title: Built-in protocol family
builtin_detail.description: {{family}} is a built-in protocol family. It can't be edited or removed.

detail.default_description: Pick one from the list to see its details.

form.step_family_hint: Select the CLI this command is compatible with.
form.family_locked_hint: The base runtime cannot be changed after creation.
form.error_command_trailing_escape: Complete or remove the trailing backslash before saving.
form.error_command_shell_syntax: Shell pipelines, redirects, and control operators are not supported. Use a wrapper script for that.
form.error_command_shell_expansion: Shell variable and command expansion is not supported. Use an absolute path or wrapper script.
form.error_duplicate_name: A runtime with this display name already exists.

delete_dialog.title: Delete custom runtime from workspace?
delete_dialog.description: "{{name}}" will be removed from this workspace and every machine where it is registered. This can't be undone.
delete_dialog.error_bound: This custom runtime can't be deleted while agents are still using it — including agents on other machines that registered it.

usage.empty_zero_cost: Tokens recorded but cost calculation returned $0.
usage.unmapped_notice_one: {{count}} model has no maintained price — its tokens are excluded from cost totals.
usage.unmapped_notice_other: {{count}} models have no maintained price — their tokens are excluded from cost totals.

custom_pricing.active_notice: Some models in this period are priced with your custom rates.
custom_pricing.title: Custom model prices
custom_pricing.description: Enter per-million-token rates so we can price models we don't ship a maintained rate for. Stored locally on this machine.
custom_pricing.empty: No models need a custom price right now.
custom_pricing.unit_hint: All rates are USD per 1M tokens. Leave every field blank to remove an override.

qoder.title: QCA runtime
qoder.description: Connect Qoder Cloud Agent. Multica manages execution and stores credentials encrypted. Workspace administrators can change this configuration.
qoder.unavailable: Server setup is required: configure MULTICA_VCS_SECRET_KEY.
qoder.name: Runtime name
qoder.region_hint: Use the site where you created the PAT; a PAT only works in its own region.
qoder.keep_secret: Leave blank to keep the saved token
qoder.repositories_hint: Bind a token to each repository. Select the repository and starting branch in your project. Tokens are never returned by the server.
qoder.saved: Saved. The server will start the runtime automatically.
qoder.no_environments: No available environments. Create one in Qoder, then refresh.
qoder.agent_hint: Use the PAT saved in the remote runtime to link a QCA Agent. Manage its model, tools and skills in Qoder.
qoder.no_agents: No available QCA Agents. Create one in Qoder, then refresh.
qoder.agent_unavailable: The linked QCA Agent is unavailable. Select another agent.
qoder.agent_save_failed: Could not save QCA Agent association
qoder.cloud_description: Run agents in Qoder Cloud using a shared connection, without maintaining a local host.
qoder.add_agent_description: Create a Multica agent linked to an existing QCA Agent. It will use the environment and credentials configured for Qoder Cloud.
qoder.shared_credentials_hint: Credentials are shared within this workspace. PATs are encrypted and never displayed after saving.
qoder.concurrency_hint: Runs beyond this limit wait in the queue.
qoder.run_timeout_hint: A run still going after this long is cancelled and marked failed.
qoder.data_disclosure: The issue title and description, relevant comments, project context and the agent's instructions. GitHub tokens are only used to mount the repository for a run.
qoder.default_repository_hint: Mounted when the issue's project has no repository. The connection needs a GitHub token for it.

connect.connected: Qoder connected. It will be ready in a few seconds.
connect.token_rejected: {{region}} does not accept this token. A token only works on the site that created it.
connect.environment_waiting: Environments load once the token is verified
connect.execution_summary: Up to {{concurrency}} at once · {{timeout}} min timeout

stop_confirm.title: Pause Qoder Cloud Agent?
stop_confirm.description: New tasks will not be sent to Qoder until it is resumed.
stop_confirm.description_agents_one: This agent keeps its instructions and history but cannot take new tasks until Qoder is resumed or it moves to another runtime.
stop_confirm.description_agents_other: These {{count}} agents keep their instructions and history but cannot take new tasks until Qoder is resumed or they move to another runtime.

qoder.connect_description: Connect once with a Qoder PAT. Multica runs tasks in Qoder's sandboxes and stores credentials encrypted.

page.pause_hint: Stop sending new tasks to Qoder. Credentials and agents stay, and you can resume anytime.
page.resume_hint: Start taking tasks again with the saved configuration.
page.disconnect_hint: Delete the saved PAT and repository tokens and remove this runtime. Agents using it are unbound and keep their history.
page.not_connected_hint: Ask a workspace admin to connect Qoder Cloud Agent.
page.edit_connection_hint: The connection is tested before it's saved.
page.repositories_hint: Agents can only clone the repositories authorized here.
page.remove_repository_description: Its token is deleted and agents can no longer clone it.

disconnect_confirm.title: Disconnect Qoder Cloud Agent?
disconnect_confirm.description: The saved PAT and repository tokens are deleted and the Qoder runtime is removed. To use Qoder again, connect it from scratch.
disconnect_confirm.description_agents_one: This agent will be unbound. It keeps its instructions and history and can move to another runtime.
disconnect_confirm.description_agents_other: These {{count}} agents will be unbound. They keep their instructions and history and can move to another runtime.
disconnect_confirm.plan_changed: The agents on Qoder changed. Review the list and confirm again.
